parents.result: Phi-3 free generation passed 15/16 but changed an unrelated supplied noun once.
Qwen2-7B free generation passed 7/16 and frequently rewrote the subject or determiners.

measured_bottleneck: Free-generation grammar surveys confound source grammatical preference with rewrite and minimal-edit adherence. V66 shows Phi-3 usually knows the correction but can still fail the exact extraction contract by rewriting another token.
hypothesis: Counterbalanced forced-choice log-probability extraction can read the frozen source's grammatical preference directly while cancelling A/B position bias, avoiding free-generation rewrite noise and importing only the selected preference rather than source machinery.

method.name: counterbalanced_forced_choice_log_probability
method.pass_rule: The correct sentence must have strictly higher completion log probability than the incorrect sentence with correct at B and again with correct at A.
method.claim_boundary: The teacher validates the linguistic choice already present in each pair. This can supply compact grammar supervision but cannot by itself prove general English, ABI-to-LayerCake transfer, or any LayerCake performance property.

decision_rule: Run one 16-row Phi-3 float16 CUDA contrastive preflight with the frozen implementation and catalog.
Authorize one full 224-row run only if at least 14 rows pass both counterbalanced orders and all identity, accounting, CUDA, finite-margin, and uniqueness checks pass.
Qualify grammar only if every global and per-structure full gate passes without threshold revision.

If full qualification passes, construct a new immutable grammar source artifact containing only passing search corrections and exact source-preference provenance, with stored-logit and source-compute accounting.
Combine that artifact with only V62's separately qualified thirteen inventories under a new preregistered multi-source protocol.
Do not invoke LayerCake until the combined artifact passes segregation and adequacy.
failure_attribution: A V68 failure is ABI_CONTRASTIVE_EXTRACTION_FAILURE, never a LayerCake failure.
